title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #11

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a single verse of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. A juz
   B. An ayah
   C. A surah
   D. A rak'ah

2. What is a chapter of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. An ayah
   B. A surah
   C. A rak'ah
   D. A sujud

3. What is the meaning of "adab of eating"? (1 mark)
   A. A fast
   B. A type of food
   C. The etiquette or good manners of eating
   D. A prayer

4. Which is an example of wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Taking a small portion
   B. Finishing your food
   C. Sharing leftovers with a neighbour
   D. Throwing away half a plate you took

5. What should we say after finishing a meal? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Inna lillahi
   C. Alhamdulillah
   D. Bismillah

6. According to the syllabus hadith, brushing teeth is a means of (1 mark)
   A. Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   B. Gaining money
   C. Avoiding prayer
   D. Making teeth white only

7. What is a siwak? (1 mark)
   A. A small stick used to clean the teeth
   B. A water pot
   C. A prayer mat
   D. A type of cloth

8. Who does the hadith in Muslim say is better and more beloved to Allah? (1 mark)
   A. The rich person
   B. The strong believer
   C. The weak believer
   D. The tall person

9. The Prophet (S.A.W.) is reported to have raced with which wife? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija (R.A.)
   B. Aisha (R.A.)
   C. Safiyya (R.A.)
   D. Hafsa (R.A.)

10. What does "Al-Basir" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King
   B. The All-Seeing
   C. The All-Hearing
   D. The Most Merciful

11. "Ya Sami', hear my dua." Which name is used? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahim
   B. Al-Basir
   C. As-Sami'
   D. Al-Malik

12. Which dua matches the name As-Salam? (1 mark)
   A. Give me many toys
   B. Grant us peace in our home and country
   C. Make me famous
   D. Let me win

13. Which name teaches that Allah owns everything we have? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahim
   B. As-Salam
   C. As-Sami'
   D. Al-Malik

14. What should we remember when we think of Israfil? (1 mark)
   A. Rain will stop
   B. We must fear dogs
   C. The Day of Judgement is true
   D. Prayer is not needed

15. How many pillars of Iman are there? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Five
   C. Ten
   D. Seven

16. Who was the brother who helped Prophet Musa? (1 mark)
   A. Harun
   B. Ilyas
   C. Yahya
   D. Idris

17. What is mud on your clothes? (1 mark)
   A. Normal dirt, not a najasa
   B. A medium najasa
   C. A heavy najasa
   D. A light najasa

18. Before touching the written Qur'an (Mushaf), a Muslim should (1 mark)
   A. Have wudhu
   B. Skip cleaning
   C. Only wash feet
   D. Be in a hurry

19. If you are sure you made wudhu and only doubt that it broke, what should you assume? (1 mark)
   A. You must never pray
   B. You are still in wudhu
   C. Your wudhu is broken
   D. You are in ghusl

20. Which is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Prostrating
   B. Taslim
   C. Facing the Qibla
   D. Bowing

21. What must a boy cover at the least during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Only the feet
   B. Nothing
   C. Only the face
   D. From navel to knees

22. What is tuma'ninah? (1 mark)
   A. Speed
   B. Calmness in each position
   C. Loudness
   D. Ignoring order

23. To which sides do we turn for taslim? (1 mark)
   A. Backwards
   B. Up
   C. Only forward
   D. Right, then left

24. What is qiyam? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting
   B. Standing
   C. Prostration
   D. Bowing

25. What should you do if you find an injured bird? (1 mark)
   A. Kick it
   B. Play with it
   C. Ignore it
   D. Ask an adult to help

26. What does adornment mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Making oneself look neat and nice
   C. Praying
   D. Hiding

27. What does the Qur'an (7:26) say is the best clothing? (1 mark)
   A. The clothing of righteousness
   B. The most expensive
   C. The brightest
   D. The newest

28. Which is an evil of begging? (1 mark)
   A. Loss of dignity
   B. Higher income
   C. More friends
   D. Better skills

29. What does the dua for entering the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend
   B. Say He is Allah
   C. Read in the name
   D. Guide us

30. Which name of Allah reminds us He hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman
   B. Al-Malik
   C. As-Salam
   D. As-Sami'

31. What did the Prophet say about dua? (1 mark)
   A. It is a game
   B. It is worship
   C. It is only for old people
   D. It is not needed

32. How should parents correct children? (1 mark)
   A. With wisdom and gentleness
   B. By insults
   C. With cruelty
   D. By ignoring

33. Which shows disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Speaking softly
   B. Greeting parents
   C. Helping with dishes
   D. Slamming doors and refusing to help

34. Who is a "bibi"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandfather
   B. Cousin
   C. Grandmother
   D. Uncle

35. What does the Kaaba represent? (1 mark)
   A. The House built to worship Allah alone
   B. A school
   C. A market
   D. A palace

36. What does "'Alaq" refer to in Surah Al-Alaq? (1 mark)
   A. A cave
   B. A pen
   C. A clinging clot
   D. A mountain

37. What was the Prophet's answer? (1 mark)
   A. He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   B. He said yes
   C. He said nothing
   D. He asked for destruction

38. Why did the Prophet go to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. To relax
   B. To trade
   C. To hide
   D. To invite people to Islam

39. Which virtue is needed if a classmate teases you? (1 mark)
   A. Revenge
   B. Fighting
   C. Patience and tolerance
   D. Shouting

40. What is perseverance? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping on with determination
   B. Anger
   C. Giving up
   D. Laziness

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong. (4 marks)

42. Explain why Muslims do not worship angels. (3 marks)

43. State four obligations of parents to their children. (4 marks)

44. Explain how the Prophet (S.A.W.) showed love to children. (3 marks)

45. State the duties of Jibril, Mikail and Israfil. (3 marks)

46. State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth. (2 marks)

47. Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent. (3 marks)

48. Who were the three earliest converts studied in this lesson? (2 marks)

49. Write a media plan for a week for a Grade 4 child following Islamic manners. (5 marks)

50. Name three types of media and give one example of each. (3 marks)

51. Give the meanings of shangazi, mjomba and binamu. (3 marks)

52. How can planting a tree be an act of worship? (2 marks)

53. Describe what happened to Taif in later years. (3 marks)

54. Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah. (3 marks)

55. Describe how to clean a place licked by a dog. (3 marks)

56. Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house. (3 marks)

57. State two reasons why a Muslim recites Al-Fatiha in every prayer. (2 marks)

58. Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an. (3 marks)

59. Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health. (4 marks)

60. Name the first and the last prophet. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — An ayah
   Ayah (plural ayat) means verse; a chapter is a surah.

2. B — A surah
   A surah is a chapter made of ayat.

3. C — The etiquette or good manners of eating
   Adab means manners.

4. D — Throwing away half a plate you took
   Taking more than you can eat causes waste.

5. C — Alhamdulillah
   Alhamdulillah thanks Allah for the food.

6. A — Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   The hadith says it purifies the mouth and pleases Allah.

7. A — A small stick used to clean the teeth
   The siwak comes from the arak tree.

8. B — The strong believer
   Both have good, but the strong believer is more beloved.

9. B — Aisha (R.A.)
   Reports say he raced Aisha.

10. B — The All-Seeing
   Al-Basir sees everything.

11. C — As-Sami'
   Sami' means All-Hearing.

12. B — Grant us peace in our home and country
   As-Salam is the Source of Peace.

13. D — Al-Malik
   Everything belongs to the true King.

14. C — The Day of Judgement is true
   The Trumpet will be blown by Allah's command.

15. A — Six
   There are six pillars of Iman.

16. A — Harun
   Harun was Musa's brother and helper.

17. A — Normal dirt, not a najasa
   Mud is not najasa though we clean for neatness.

18. A — Have wudhu
   Most scholars say wudhu is required.

19. B — You are still in wudhu
   Doubt does not remove certainty.

20. C — Facing the Qibla
   Facing Qibla is a condition; bowing is a pillar.

21. D — From navel to knees
   This is the minimum.

22. B — Calmness in each position
   Staying still for a moment.

23. D — Right, then left
   We greet to the right and left.

24. B — Standing
   Qiyam means standing.

25. D — Ask an adult to help
   Get help from an adult.

26. B — Making oneself look neat and nice
   Adornment is beautifying.

27. A — The clothing of righteousness
   Good character is best.

28. A — Loss of dignity
   Begging lowers dignity.

29. A — In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend
   That is the meaning.

30. D — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' is the All-Hearing.

31. B — It is worship
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

32. A — With wisdom and gentleness
   Islam forbids cruelty.

33. D — Slamming doors and refusing to help
   Rudeness is wrong.

34. C — Grandmother
   Bibi means grandmother.

35. A — The House built to worship Allah alone
   Ibrahim and Ismail built it.

36. C — A clinging clot
   Man was created from a clinging clot.

37. A — He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   He chose mercy.

38. D — To invite people to Islam
   He wanted support.

39. C — Patience and tolerance
   Stay calm.

40. A — Keeping on with determination
   The Prophet continued to invite.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: He kissed and hugged them, including his grandson Al-Hasan, and said that those who show no mercy will not be shown mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brings revelation, Mikail is in charge of rain and provision, Israfil will blow the Trumpet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Khadija, Ali and Abu Bakr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two names and 1 mark for the third.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Screen time limit after homework; no screens at prayer or meal times; educational and Islamic content; ask permission; tell an adult if unsafe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid item up to 5.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Print: newspaper; broadcast: radio; internet: video website.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type with example.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shangazi: father's sister; mjomba: mother's brother; binamu: cousin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: People or animals eat from it, and this counts as charity for the planter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for charity and 1 mark for eating from it.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash seven times with water, one washing being mixed with clean soil, then rinse and dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seven washings, 1 mark for soil once, 1 mark for rinsing.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a pillar of the prayer, and it praises Allah and asks Him for guidance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam was the first and Muhammad (S.A.W.) was the last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
